title: Another course reveals significance

captions.physics: Returning to subjects directly and kindly
captions.emotions: Feeling significance in newly heard needs

meaning: You can return to a subject directly and kindly and respond to changed conditions, feeling significance in a need heard anew without immediately completing the conversation.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Sun in the physical position appears in directly and kindly returning to a subject. The Wheel of Fortune in energy supports a wish to respond to changed conversational conditions. Judgement in emotions brings significance to a need heard anew. You can preserve clear participation and notice why the question itself matters rather than the earlier form of reply. New understanding prescribes no identical readiness to continue immediately.

For example, people you know unexpectedly join the exchange. You warmly say, “I want to return to what you asked”, and clarify whether continuing with others present feels appropriate. **Changed conditions can reveal a question’s significance more clearly**. It emerges that a personal response mattered rather than an answer within a general discussion. This discovery may resonate strongly. Yet postponement promises no compulsory openness later; actual readiness remains a separate question still needing to be heard.

Difficulty appears if strongly feeling importance becomes a right to an immediate personal answer despite new conditions. Significance replaces genuine agreement. The constructive Wheel of Fortune helps consider events without losing the request’s substance. You can take it seriously and not continue yet; responding to discovered meaning requires no identical emotional intensity, while a direct warm intention to revisit a question does not automatically cover every possible detail or a time assigned in advance.
